title: Prescribed extension spectra of mock automorphisms over finite fields
summary: We classify the finite-extension permutation spectra occurring in an explicit family of mock automorphisms over finite fields. Every finite nonempty divisor-closed subset of $\N_{>0}$ occurs; in particular, this disproves Maubach and Willems conjecture that every mock automorphism permutes infinitely many finite extensions. Every finite-spectrum map satisfying \[ \Jac(F)=I_n,\qquad F|_{\F_q^n}=\id \] has total degree at least $p(q+1)$. For every $n\geq2$, this bound is attained by a map with spectrum $\{1\}$.
